notes: Every record conforms to docs/equity_module/v0.1/equity_registry_shared_metadata.schema.json (object_family=entity_type). Restrictive defaults applied where rights or PIT are ambiguous. User-private entities default to license_policy=internal_research_only; export and marketplace blocked until the user explicitly upgrades.

records.description: Tradable equity instrument identified by an immutable security_id and mapped to issuer, company, share_class, and one or more listings. Never keyed by ticker (CLAUDE.md project rule).
Operating business / economic enterprise. Keyed by immutable company_id; references include CIK (SEC), LEI, and DUNS where available.
Legal issuer of securities. Distinct from `company` (operating entity) and `equity_security` (instrument). Identified by issuer_id; references include LEI and CIK.
Class of equity claims (e.g., Class A common, Class B common, preferred). Preserved through reclassifications and spin-offs via provenance chain.
Exchange-specific traded listing of a security. A security may have multiple listings across exchanges and currencies.
US-listed receipt representing foreign equity shares. Always linked to an underlying foreign equity_security via `adr_of_underlying_security` edge.
Top-level sector classification (GICS sector or equivalent). Hierarchical parent of industry.
Industry classification (e.g., GICS industry). Child of sector, parent of subindustry.
Most granular GICS-style classification level used for peer-set selection (Bhojraj-Lee).
Methodology-bound set of companies treated as peers for valuation / comparison. Construction must declare methodology (Bhojraj-Lee, Hoberg-Phillips text-based, or explicit list).
Provider-defined equity index (e.g., S&P 500, Russell 2000, MSCI ACWI). Membership and methodology are licensed where applicable.
Strategy- or portfolio-bound benchmark. May reference an `index` or be a custom composite. Required for benchmark-relative mandates.
User- or system-owned portfolio with mandate, benchmark, constraints, and a set of positions. User-private by default.
Holding of a security inside a portfolio. User-private by default; never exported without explicit user action.
User- or system-owned watchlist binding monitored entities to triggers. User-private by default.
SEC/regulator filing (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, DEF 14A, 13D/G, 13F, Form 4, etc.). Authoritative PIT timestamp is filing_accepted_at.

Structured financial statement derived from a filing (10-K/10-Q/20-F/6-K) with income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, and footnotes. Pinned to filing_accepted_at; restatements form an amendment chain.
DEF 14A (or equivalent) proxy filing carrying board composition, compensation, ownership, related-party, and shareholder-vote disclosures.
Scheduled investor call for an earnings release. Anchor for transcripts, surprise computations, and guidance events.
Earnings-call or investor-event transcript. Typically vendor-provided and licensed; cite + paraphrase only without redistribution rights.
Company- or wire-issued press release. Authoritative for company-originated guidance/M&A/material announcement timestamps.
Third-party news article or wire item. Authoritative source for news-based sentiment, rumor detection, and catalyst observation when paired with credibility classification.
User-authored investment note or memo attached to an entity, thesis, or decision. Private by default; never exported without explicit user action.
Timestamped occurrence affecting an entity. Universal catalyst-bearing object used by §13 event registry and the decision lifecycle in §3.13.
Event interpreted under a strategy profile as a thesis-relevant trigger. Catalysts wrap events with horizon hints, confirmations required, and invalidation conditions.
Structured investment claim about an entity. First-class entity per §3.22; carries supporting + contradictory evidence, catalysts, risks, invalidation conditions. User-private by default.
Concrete research or portfolio action produced by the equity decision grammar (§3). Schema `viza.equity.decision.v1`. User-private.
Output recommendation-logic object (`viza.equity.recommendation_logic.v1`). Always carries a non-advice boundary; export depends on strategy profile permission.
Structured valuation model (`viza.equity.valuation_model.v1`) with assumptions, sensitivity, scenarios, valuation gap, and margin of safety.
Single named assumption inside a valuation model (`viza.equity.valuation_assumption.v1`). Carries source_type, evidence_refs, sensitivity band.
Named state of the world (bull/base/bear/regime-specific) inside a valuation or strategy run. Carries probability + assumption overrides + risk cases.
Specific risk outcome inside a scenario (e.g., deal break, FDA rejection, recession). Carries probability, severity, and invalidation triggers.
Abstract holder of an economic interest (parent type of holder/insider/etc.). Concrete subtypes carry filing-specific evidence.
Holder of an equity security. Concrete (institutional/insider/retail/etc.) subtypes attach evidence; this base type captures the universal holder identity.
13F-filing institutional manager. Carries Bushee classification (transient/dedicated/quasi_indexer).
13D/13G filer or named beneficial owner. Triggers activism-related events on 13D.
Section 16 reporting person (officer, director, 10% holder). Files Form 4 transactions; tracked for cluster and alignment signals.
Named executive officer disclosed in DEF 14A (CEO/CFO/named executive). Carries compensation, tenure, performance alignment.
Director disclosed in DEF 14A. Carries independence, tenure, committee memberships, dual-class voting.
Sell-side or independent analyst-research publisher. Required for analyst-revision evidence credibility (Loh-Stulz).
Single-analyst estimate (EPS / revenue / margin / target price) with published_at and provider PIT vintage.
Provider-derived consensus aggregate as of a specific PIT timestamp (I/B/E/S-style). Required for PIT-safe surprise calculation.
Analyst rating change or recommendation change (upgrade/downgrade/initiation/drop). PIT pinned to publication_time.

Macroeconomic time series (CPI, GDP, payrolls, rates, etc.). Vintaged via `macro_vintage` rows. PROJECT_STATUS.md notes FRED rows are currently ingestion-timestamped; downgrade until ALFRED-style vintaged pipeline ships.
Single as-of vintage of a macro series (ALFRED-style). Required for PIT-safe macro backtests.
Regulatory body (SEC, FINRA, DOJ, FTC, FDA, EU). Authoritative for enforcement, rulemaking, and approval events.
Configured external connector instance with credential ref, entitlement metadata, and PIT/rights policy. Fail-closed without credentials when production_required=true.
Concrete rights-matrix row binding a source pattern to license/display/export/redistribution/marketplace policy. Used for redaction and packaging.
Validation-framework record (`viza.equity.validation_record.v1`). Domain-tagged (graph/data/PIT/rights/evidence/statistical/portfolio/output/marketplace). Append-only.
Proof artifact carrying source refs, PIT timestamps, rights state, graph/profile hashes, and validation record refs. Cross-cutting audit object.
`.viza` exchange package (white-box, gray-box, black-box, output-only, preview, or marketplace_draft). Marketplace_draft defaults to redacted.
Ledger entry for a data-quality issue (PIT unsafe, rights restricted, stale, restatement, vintage unavailable, cross-source disagreement, provider error).
